title: How well can Text-to-Image Generative Models understand Ethical Natural Language Interventions?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the diversity and bias of images generated from neutral versus ethically intervened text prompts (e.g., 'irrespective of their gender') by categorizing generated individuals as man or woman using both automated CLIP-based image-text similarity scores and human annotations.

Evaluating the diversity and bias of images generated from neutral versus ethically intervened text prompts by having human annotators visually categorize the generated individuals as light-skinned or dark-skinned.

Evaluating images generated from cultural scenario prompts (e.g., bride, groom, wedding) with and without cultural interventions (e.g., 'from diverse cultures'), using human annotators to classify the depicted scenarios as Western or Non-Western.
